# Logistics 0.2.1-alpha.2

- In notebooks, select a drawing layer by name and toggle individual layers with the eye buttons. Imported notebooks show more tablet ink types, and the zoom controls sit closer to the bottom edge on mobile.
- On iOS, AirPlay keeps the video session active when the screen locks and resumes after a pause from the Apple TV remote.
- In desktop Blender presets, choose whether Logistics automatically updates the installed Blue Hole add-on. The setting is remembered per preset.
- The user guides are shorter and organized around common tasks. The developer guides point to the code and checks for each feature.

If you report a notebook or playback issue, include the device, OS, and the steps that triggered it.
